name: agent-fs-permission-grants
body:
The agent-grant surface for the fs tools: the `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md` template rule that generates each implementer's permission block with `apg_rm` / `apg_mv` / `apg_cp` scoped by the role's owned path globs, deny-by-default, with every allow (and every deny) mirrored under `apg/.worktrees/*/` per rule 10. It replaces the template's current `plain rm <path>` wording (rule 6) with the fs-tool grants, so generated implementers stop relying on shallow bash `rm <dir>/*.<ext>` patterns and can implement `deletes`/`renames`/`moves` tasks. It is product source in the opencode-suite distribution (`solution.container.opencode-suite`), installed by `apg init` into `~/.opencode/agents/`; the repo's own `.opencode/agents/**` are consumer artifacts and are never edited by this change-set.

implemented-by: `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md`.
